entry.title: New: Bill 5, CD1 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR" The purpose of this bill is to 1) delete the overall appropriation of $1,829,334; 2) delete Maui Family Support Services, Inc.'s Exterior Rehabilitation of MFSS Building project and the County of Maui, Department of Fire and Public Safety's Lanaʻi Fire Tanker project; 3) insert an appropriation of $296,554 for Ka Hale A Ke Ola Homeless Resource Centers, Inc.'s Phase 4, Building 4 project; 4) insert an appropriation of $365,867 for Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program Administration; and 5) add a new Affordable Rental Housing for Kupuna project for the County of Maui with an appropriation of $2,645,663.
